chapter.li: LEChapter6 Verse1 And now behold, my brethren, as I said unto 2PP you that I would prophesy, behold, this is my prophecy, that the things which this prophet Zenos spake concerning the house of Israel, in the which he likened them unto a tame olive tree, must surely come to pass. VerseEnd Verse2 And in the day that he shall set his hand again the second time to recover his people, is the day, yea, even the last time, that the servants of the Lord shall go forth in his power to nourish and prune his vineyard. And after that, the end soon cometh. VerseEnd Verse3 And how blessed are they who have labored diligently in his vineyard, and how cursed are they who shall be cast out into their own place. And the world shall be burned with fire. VerseEnd Verse4 And how merciful is our God unto us, for he remembereth the house of Israel, both roots and branches; and he stretches forth his hands unto them all the day long. And they are a stiffnecked and a gainsaying people, but as many as will not harden their hearts shall be saved in the kingdom of God. VerseEnd

Verse5 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, I beseech of 2PP you in words of soberness that 2PP ye would repent, and come with full purpose of heart, and cleave unto God as he cleaveth unto 2PP you. And while his arm of mercy is extended towards 2PP you in the light of the day, harden not 2PP your hearts. VerseEnd Verse6 Yea, today, if 2PP ye will hear his voice, harden not 2PP your hearts; for why will 2PP ye die? VerseEnd Verse7 For behold, after 2PP ye have been nourished by the good word of God all the day long, will 2PP ye bring forth evil fruit that 2PP ye must be hewn down and cast into the fire? VerseEnd Verse8 Behold, will 2PP ye reject these words? Will 2PP ye reject the words of the prophets? And will 2PP ye reject all the words which have been spoken concerning Christ after so many have spoken concerning him? VerseEnd Verse9 Know 2PP ye not that if 2PP ye will do these things, that the power of the redemption and the resurrection which is in Christ will bring 2PP you to stand with shame and awful guilt before the bar of God? VerseEnd Verse10 And according to the power of justice — for justice cannot be denied — 2PP ye must go away into that lake of fire and brimstone, whose flames are unquenchable, and whose smoke ascendeth up for ever and ever, which lake of fire and brimstone is Endless torment. VerseEnd Verse11 O then, my beloved brethren, repent 2PP ye, and enter 2PP ye in at the strait gate, and continue in the way which is narrow until 2PP ye shall obtain eternal life. VerseEnd Verse12 Oh be wise. What can I say more? VerseEnd Verse13 Finally, I bid 2PP you farewell, until I shall meet 2PP you before the pleasing bar of God, which bar striketh the wicked with awful dread and fear. Amen. VerseEnd
